 Here are the Predictions for YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026, 65th Match (Super 8) - Eastern Storm vs Dolphins, to be played on the 6th of November at the Willowmoore Park, Benoni.
 Match Prediction - Eastern Storm v Dolphins 
 LIVE SCORES - 65th Match (Super 8) - Eastern Storm vs Dolphins (Willowmoore Park, Benoni) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Willowmoore Park, Benoni (CSA T20 Challenge) - 157
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Willowmoore Park, Benoni (CSA T20 Challenge) - 148
 Current Form Eastern Storm: 
 In the Super 8's, Eastern Storm are currently placed at the bottom most position with 5 losses to their credit. They have 0 point to their name.
 The top run scorer for Eastern Storm in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Jurie Snyman with 276 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Eastern Storm in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Aryan Gopalam with 7 scalps under his belt .
 Eastern Storm have lost their previous match against South Western Districts by 6 wickets.
 Eastern Storm batted first and they posted a total of 144 for 7 in 20 overs. Kabelo Sekhukhune and Ronan Hermann started off quite slow for Eastern Storm. They used up way too many deliveries in the Powerplay overs and looked in troubled waters. Christopher Britz and Jurie Snyman got the starts but they also threw it away when it mattered the most. Leo Sadler was the star of the show with the ball in hand. He picked up 3 wickets for only 16 runs and helped restrict Eastern Storm to 144 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Yaseen Vallie and Janneman Malan batted superbly in the Powerplay overs. Janneman Malan in particular was simply sensational with the bat. Vallie made 26 while Malan scored 75 runs off 57 balls to seal the deal in favor of South Western Districts. Liam Alder also played a whirlwind cameo of 18 runs in only 4 balls and helped South Western Districts get over the line in the 19th over with 6 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Dolphins: 
 Dolphins are currently placed at the 7th position on Group B points table with 1 win and 3 losses and 1 No Result Match to their credit. They have 7 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Dolphins in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Jason Smith with 211 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Dolphins in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Prenelan Subrayen with 11 scalps under his belt .
 Dolphins have lost their previous match against Boland by 7 wickets.
 Dolphins batted first and they posted a total of 174 for 4 in 20 overs. The start was terrible as Romashan Pillay, Bryce Parsons and Jason Smith all got out without troubling the scorers much. Dolphins were reduced to 12 for 3 in the 4th over itself. After that phase, Ntando Zuma and Hanu Viljoen took the responsibility of taking Dolphins to a competitive total. Zuma made 42 while Hanu Viljoen went on to score 114 runs in only 59 deliveries as Dolphins managed to reach 174 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Blayde Capell and Gavin Kaplan gave Boland a dream start. Kaplan made 55 runs in 44 balls while Capell scored 90 runs in only 53 deliveries to seal the deal in favor of Boland. Lehan Botha also contributed healthily and Boland comfortably got over the line in the last over with 7 wickets in hand.
